problem: Section 3 says the entity needs a public no-arg constructor, but the code in the worked example shows a package-private Student() {}. The JPA rule is a no-arg constructor that is public or protected, so the text over-restricts and the code contradicts the text. A student cannot tell which one is correct in the exam.
fix: Write: the entity needs a no-arg constructor, public or protected as the JPA spec requires; Hibernate also accepts a non-public one by reflection, but keep it public or protected. Change the code to public Student() {} so the rule and the sample match.
